ZipFileProcessor.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the instance by storing the provided file name on the object." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> file_name </REF>: unknown "The file name value to store on the instance."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the provided file_name value directly to the instance attribute self.file_name. RESULT self.file_name]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ZipFileProcessor.read_zip_file:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Attempts to open the configured file as a ZIP archive and returns the ZipFile object, or returns None if opening fails." read_zip_file]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance containing the file_name attribute to open as a ZIP archive."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: ZipFile or None "The opened ZIP file object on success, otherwise None if an exception occurs."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Within a try block, open the file named by self.file_name as a ZIP archive in read mode using zipfile.ZipFile. RESULT zip_file]
            [COMMAND Return the opened zip_file object. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If any exception occurs while opening the ZIP file.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None as the fallback result. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ZipFileProcessor.extract_all:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Extract all contents from the ZIP archive at the specified output path and return true on success or false if any exception occurs." extract_all]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> output_path </REF>: path-like "Destination directory where the archive contents should be extracted."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "True if extraction succeeds; false if any exception is raised during processing."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Try to open the archive stored in self.file_name as a ZIP file in read mode and bind it to zip_file. RESULT zip_file]
            [COMMAND Within the open ZIP file, extract all archive contents into output_path. RESULT extraction_result]
            [COMMAND If extraction completes without error, return True. RESULT true]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If any exception occurs while opening the ZIP file or extracting its contents, handle it by returning False.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Catch the exception from ZIP opening or extraction and stop further processing. RESULT exception_handled]
            [COMMAND Return False as the failure indicator. RESULT false]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ZipFileProcessor.extract_file:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Extracts a named file from the ZIP archive stored in self.file_name into the given output path and returns True on success or False if any exception occurs." extract_file]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> file_name </REF>: str "The name of the file to extract from the archive."
        <REF> output_path </REF>: str "The destination path where the file should be extracted."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "True if the extraction succeeds; otherwise False."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Attempt to open the ZIP archive located at self.file_name in read mode. RESULT zip_file]
            [COMMAND Within the opened ZIP archive, extract the specified file_name into output_path. RESULT extraction_result]
            [COMMAND If extraction completes without error, return True. RESULT True]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If any exception occurs while opening the ZIP archive or extracting the file, return False instead of propagating the error.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Catch the exception raised during ZIP opening or extraction. RESULT caught_exception]
            [COMMAND Return False as the failure result. RESULT False]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ZipFileProcessor.create_zip_file:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Create a ZIP archive at the given output path by writing each file from the input list, returning True on success and False if any exception occurs." create_zip_file]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> files </REF>: list "A collection of file paths to add to the ZIP archive."
        <REF> output_file_name </REF>: str "The destination ZIP file path to create."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "True if the ZIP file is created and all files are written successfully; otherwise False."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Try to open a ZIP archive at output_file_name in write mode and bind it to zip_file. RESULT zip_file]
            [COMMAND Within the ZIP archive context, iterate over each file in files. RESULT file]
            [COMMAND For each file in files, write the file into the ZIP archive. RESULT zip_file.write(file)]
            [COMMAND After all files are written successfully, return True. RESULT True]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If an exception occurs at any point while creating the ZIP archive or writing files, catch it and return False.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND On exception, skip any remaining ZIP processing. RESULT abort_zip_creation]
            [COMMAND Return False to indicate failure. RESULT False]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
